title: Park Atidim operator board occupancy config
description: Occupancy/validity config merged over ParkWizAtidimLot.DEFAULT by demo/atidim-board.html (fetch of demo/atidim-data.json). cols and rows must be positive integers so totalBays() is not 0/NaN.

site.description: Display name of the lot shown on the operator board.

cols.description: Number of bay columns in the board plan view.

rows.description: Number of bay rows in the board plan view.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to pick the hour on the occupancy curve (e.g. Asia/Jerusalem).

meetingNote.description: Optional presenter note (synthetic data, not a live camera).
